limits.source: Read from the pre-run snapshot of each run: limits.board_power_limit, limits.asic_fmax and limits.therm_trip_l1_limit as in #137; smbus_telem.BOARD_POWER_LIMIT (expected 0x12c) and ENABLED_MAX_ARB (expected 0x1d1) as the per-run configuration check. The GDDR thermal limit has no telemetry tag; its value 85 is from the firmware config table and is recorded as such. A pre-run snapshot whose BOARD_POWER_LIMIT or ENABLED_MAX_ARB differs from the expected word makes the run not_evaluable (configuration), never substituted.
